name: Google Ads API
description: The Google Ads API lets developers build tools and integrations that manage Google Ads accounts, campaigns, ads, keywords, bidding strategies, budgets, reporting, and conversions. The REST interface mirrors the gRPC API with resource-oriented URL patterns using custom methods such as :mutate, :search, and :searchStream.
